picks.title: Y Combinator alum Skio sells for $105M cash, only raised $8M, founder says
picks.why_it_matters: A 13x return on just $8M raised demonstrates that capital-efficient startups in unsexy fintech infrastructure can still deliver exceptional outcomes for early investors.

picks.title: Legal AI startup Legora hits $5.6B valuation and its battle with Harvey just got hotter
picks.why_it_matters: The intensifying legal AI battle signals a maturing vertical AI market where adjacent opportunities (contract management, compliance, legal ops tooling) may emerge for early-stage founders.

picks.title: Exclusive: Data center firm inks carbon removal deal as AI demand surges
picks.why_it_matters: As AI infrastructure scales, data center operators face mounting pressure to offset emissions—creating a growing market for climate tech startups targeting enterprise sustainability buyers.
